verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Logseq automatically creates a new Journals page each day and that Logseq opens to the Journals page by default, satisfying the 'automatic daily note as default landing place' part of the story. However, no evidence explicitly documents template pre-filling of the daily note (e.g. a configurable journal template feature), so the 'pre-filled from template' element is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of journal/day template pre-fill, independent hands-on confirmation of the default-landing and templating behavior.
